justification: Standard: one new table (migration 127) filled with 126 rows by a script that backs up first, one read added to the evidence endpoint, and one new column on the evidence page. Not Minor: it writes to the production database and is a served surface. Not Critical: the table is new and holds only checks, nothing existing is changed or deleted, and every verdict comes from the matcher already used for the current files (dcp_quote_status.classify).

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_source_versions holds 803 stored files; 157 chapters have more than one version; Penrith has 4 stored versions in 2 chapters and 6 current dwelling house controls. The current files already carry quote_status from dcp_quote_status.py.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: I expected the matcher to need a new copy. It does not: the script imports dcp_quote_status.classify so a verdict for an older file means the same as for the current one. A control's page number comes from its own current file, so an older file that repaginated gives wrong_page, which is not an error in the control.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: dcp_setback_controls.quote_status covers the current file only. The new table adds per-version verdicts; nothing in the existing table changes.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A PDF that cannot be read gives no_source, never verbatim. If the table cannot be read the page says Could not be read, and a control with no rows says Not checked.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_evidence_statement.py tests/test_dcp_quote_version_check.py -q ; PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 DATABASE_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_version_check_real_db.py -o addopts= -m database
falsifiable_check.fails_when: An older file that repaginated is called verbatim, a reworded file is called verbatim, an unreadable PDF passes, a check made on an older wording is shown as current, or an unreadable table is shown as no checks.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Not run red first; the verdict tests pin the matcher's outputs for each case and the real database test checks the written rows.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: 21 Python tests pass, 2 real database tests pass, 6 frontend tests pass. The fill wrote 126 rows: 104 verbatim, 16 wrong_page, 6 not_found, equal to the dry run.

functions.name: _check
functions.input: the current dwelling house controls and the stored file versions of their chapters
functions.output: one verdict per control and file version, using the shared matcher
functions.if_none: a control with no stored version gets no row; a PDF that cannot be read gives no_source

functions.name: _write
functions.input: the checked verdicts and the council filter
functions.output: rows upserted into dcp_quote_version_check after a backup file
functions.if_none: no table or a control that changed while checking aborts with nothing written

functions.name: _version_checks
functions.input: the control ids on the page and their current quotes
functions.output: the stored verdicts per control with a stale flag
functions.if_none: an unreadable table gives status unreadable; no rows gives status none

values.value: verdict per control and file version
values.if_missing: shown as Not checked, never as verbatim

values.read_at: hash of the control quote at check time against its hash now
values.if_missing: a changed quote marks the verdict stale on the page

queries.purpose: Current dwelling house controls to check
queries.where_clause: WHERE is_current AND needs_review is not true AND dev_type = dwelling_house; dry run uses a read-only connection, 30 s limit

queries.purpose: Stored file versions to check against
Read the stored verdicts for the controls on the page
queries.where_clause: WHERE control_id = ANY(page controls); read-only connection, 8 s limit

break_it.scenario: An older file was repaginated, so the quote is on another page.
break_it.what_happens: It would be called a failure of the control or, worse, a pass.
break_it.how: The matcher returns wrong_page, shown as Same words, on a different page of this file.

break_it.scenario: An older file has different wording.
break_it.what_happens: The old text could be shown as matching the current words.
break_it.how: The verdict is not_found and the page says these words were not found in this file; Penrith front setback v1.1 shows it.

break_it.scenario: A PDF cannot be read or has no text.
break_it.what_happens: A pass would be recorded for a file nobody could read.
break_it.how: The verdict is no_source and the page says this file could not be read.

break_it.scenario: A control's quote is edited after its check was stored.
break_it.what_happens: The page would show an old verdict as if it matched the new words.
break_it.how: The stored quote hash no longer matches, the verdict is marked stale and the page says the check was made on an older wording.

break_it.scenario: The control is deleted or re-extracted while the script runs.
break_it.what_happens: Verdicts could be written for a control that no longer exists.
break_it.how: The write aborts with nothing written if any checked control is no longer current, and the table cascades on delete.

post_merge.manual_verify: Migration 127 and the fill were already applied on 2026-11-20 (126 rows). Open the evidence page for 2 Hand Avenue and read the new column: Front setback v1.1 should say these words were not found in this file.
